description_en: Migrates an instance across hosts in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 调用MigrateDBInstance接口迁移专属集群内的RDS实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds migrate-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-4nxxxxxxx --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk5xxxxxxx --target-dedicated-host-id-for-master i-bpxxxxxxx1 --target-dedicated-host-id-for-slave i-bpxxxxxxx2 --effective-time MaintainTime --specified-time 2019-10-21T10:00:00Z --zone-id-for-log cn-hangzhou-k --zone-id-for-follower cn-hangzhou-j --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateDBInstance

parameters.description_en:
The time when you want the system to start the migration. Valid values:

*   **Immediately**: The system immediately starts the migration. This is the default value.
*   **MaintainTime**: The system starts the migration during the specified maintenance window.
*   **Specified**: The system starts the migration at the specified point in time.
parameters.description_zh:
迁移时间。取值：
* **Immediately**：立即切换（默认）
* **MaintainTime**：在运维时间段切换
* **Specified**：指定时间切换

parameters.description_en:
The point in time when you want the system to start the migration. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> This parameter must be specified when you set **EffectiveTime** to **Specified**.
parameters.description_zh: 指定切换的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 >当**EffectiveTime**=**Specified**时需要填入本参数。
